book_title: How to Win Friends and Influence People
author: Dale Carnegie

scenes.script_text: How to Win Friends and Influence People by Dale Carnegie in two minutes.
scenes.visual_concept: Colossal centered upright book 'HOW TO WIN FRIENDS AND INFLUENCE PEOPLE - DALE CARNEGIE' with 100% level horizontal gold embossed lettering, zero tilt, zero neck bending. Kai and Maya stand in social influence mastery: Kai holding a glowing golden horseshoe magnet drawing stickmen friends closer, Maya snapping heavy iron chains labeled 'EGO & PRIDE' into broken links with comic sparks. Speech bubble: 'The Secret Social Superpower!'.

scenes.script_text: Most people believe human beings are creatures of logic.
scenes.visual_concept: A robotic stickman walking stiffly with mechanical gears turning inside his head, holding a glowing chalkboard filled with rigid math equations and logic gates [A + B = C].

scenes.script_text: In reality, we are creatures of emotion,
scenes.visual_concept: Inside a stickman's chest, a massive glowing pulsing heart of red emotion expands dramatically, pushing aside cold robotic wires.

scenes.script_text: driven by pride and ego.
scenes.visual_concept: A giant hot-air balloon labeled 'PRIDE & EGO' inflating violently above a crowd of stick figures, pulling them off balance with comic panic.

scenes.script_text: If you want to gather honey, don't kick over the beehive.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman with a bruised comic face running frantically away from a swarm of angry buzzing bees after violently kicking a wooden beehive; golden honey spills wasted onto the ground.

scenes.script_text: Rule Number One: Never criticize, condemn, or complain.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai standing firmly in front of a giant bold road sign reading 'RULE 1: NO CRITICISM', crossing his arms with a knowing smirk and holding a padlock over a speech bubble.

scenes.script_text: Criticism puts people on the defensive and wounds their pride.
scenes.visual_concept: Harsh red jagged lightning words labeled 'YOU'RE WRONG!' blasting toward a defensive stickman, who cowers behind a thick spiked metal shield labeled 'EGO DEFENSE'.

scenes.script_text: Even notorious criminals justify their actions.
scenes.visual_concept: A comic stickman gangster behind prison bars wearing a black fedora and striped suit, pouting innocently and pointing to a glowing letter: 'Under my coat is a weary heart that would hurt nobody.'

scenes.script_text: If a killer believes he has a tender heart,
scenes.visual_concept: The gangster looking into a small vanity mirror with comically huge puppy-dog eyes and a tiny floating halo above his fedora.

scenes.script_text: ordinary people will never blame themselves.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya with analytical comic eyes watching an ordinary stickman knocking over a vase of flowers, immediately pointing an accusing finger at the innocent pet cat.

scenes.script_text: Rule Number Two: Give honest and sincere appreciation.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya holding up a glowing golden plaque reading 'RULE 2: SINCERE APPRECIATION', illuminating the room with warm golden rays of light.

scenes.script_text: The deepest craving in human nature is the desire to feel important.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman standing on tiptoe, desperately reaching his thin arms up toward a glowing golden star labeled 'FEELING IMPORTANT' that radiates hunger lines.

scenes.script_text: Flattery is fake, but sincere praise is life-changing.
scenes.visual_concept: Two-panel side-by-side contrast: Left, an insincere snake-oil stickman offering cheap plastic fake flowers that instantly wilt; Right, Kai placing a genuine glowing gold medal of honor around a humble stickman's neck, bringing tears of joy.

scenes.script_text: Praise the slightest improvement, and be lavish in your encouragement.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya crouching down with an encouraging warm smile, clapping enthusiastically as a tiny stickman successfully takes one wobbly baby step up a steep staircase.

scenes.script_text: Rule Number Three: Spark in the other person an eager want.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai revealing a glowing blueprint labeled 'RULE 3: EAGER WANT', holding a magic sparkler igniting excitement in another stickman's eyes.

scenes.script_text: When you go fishing, you don't bait the hook with strawberries and cream.
scenes.visual_concept: A confused stickman fisherman dangling a silver hook baited with a delicious bowl of strawberries and cream; the fish underwater swim away laughing with comic bubble eyes.

scenes.script_text: You bait it with worms.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai smiling knowingly, baiting the fishing hook with a juicy, wiggling earthworm; a giant hungry fish instantly leaps out of the water to bite it!

scenes.script_text: Stop talking about what you want.
scenes.visual_concept: A selfish stickman shouting through a megaphone labeled 'ME! MY WANTS! MY GOALS!', while the crowd around him sticks their fingers in their ears and walks away.

scenes.script_text: Talk about what they want, and show them how to get it.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya unrolling a glowing treasure map directly in front of an eager stickman, pointing out the exact golden path leading directly to his personal dream goal.

scenes.script_text: Rule Number Four: Become genuinely interested in other people.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai holding a glowing golden magnifying glass labeled 'RULE 4: GENUINE INTEREST', leaning in attentively with bright curious comic eyes.

scenes.script_text: You can make more friends in two months by caring about others
scenes.visual_concept: A dynamic calendar flipping rapidly: '2 MONTHS'. Kai stands surrounded by a warm, joyful circle of laughing stick figure friends giving high-fives and sharing stories.

scenes.script_text: than you can in two years trying to get people interested in you.
scenes.visual_concept: A calendar covered in cobwebs: '2 YEARS'. An exhausted, flashy show-off stickman juggling torches on a stage, but the auditorium seats are completely empty.

scenes.script_text: Rule Number Five: Smile.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya pointing cheerfully to a massive glowing yellow smiley face banner labeled 'RULE 5: SMILE', beaming with an infectious radiant grin.

scenes.script_text: An action speaks louder than words,
scenes.visual_concept: A small quiet act of kindness (handing an umbrella to someone in the rain) visually outweighing a giant mountain of loud, hollow shouting text bubbles.

scenes.script_text: and a genuine smile says: I like you, you make me happy.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai flashing a warm, genuine 2D smile; a warm wave of glowing hearts and sunshine radiates across the frame, instantly brightening a gloomy stickman's face.

scenes.script_text: Rule Number Six: Remember that a person's name
scenes.visual_concept: Kai pointing to a glowing golden nametag badge pinned to a stickman's chest labeled 'RULE 6: THEIR NAME'.

scenes.script_text: is to that person the sweetest sound in any language.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman hearing his name spoken; the letters transform into floating musical notes and sweet honey drops drifting softly into his ear with pure delight.

scenes.script_text: Andrew Carnegie built a steel empire because he remembered names
scenes.visual_concept: Andrew Carnegie (a confident 2D stickman magnate in a vintage suit) standing before towering roaring steel mills, holding a ledger with thousands of names neatly memorized.

scenes.script_text: and named factories after his partners.
scenes.visual_concept: Giant steel factory gates with massive bold letters: 'EDGAR THOMSON STEEL WORKS', as partner Edgar Thomson beams with immense pride and signs a massive partnership contract.

scenes.script_text: Rule Number Seven: Be a great listener.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya wearing oversized golden headphones labeled 'RULE 7: LISTEN DEEPLY', nodding thoughtfully with complete, undivided attention.

scenes.script_text: Encourage others to talk about themselves and their achievements.
scenes.visual_concept: A proud stickman excitedly gesturing and sharing his life story with a glowing trophy, while Maya listens eagerly with chin in hand, fueling his confidence.

scenes.script_text: Rule Number Eight: The only way to get the best of an argument is to avoid it.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai calmly stepping aside like a matador as two raging charging bulls labeled 'ARGUMENT' slam their heads uselessly into thin air and exhaust themselves.

scenes.script_text: You cannot win an argument with words.
scenes.visual_concept: A boxing ring where two stickmen are pummeling each other with heavy boxing gloves made of sharp spiky word bubbles, both ending up battered, bruised, and miserable.

scenes.script_text: If you lose, you lose.
scenes.visual_concept: A dejected stickman slumping on the boxing ring mat with little comic birds circling his head, defeated.

scenes.script_text: And if you win, you crush their pride and create an enemy.
scenes.visual_concept: A smug stickman holding up a debate trophy, while the defeated opponent glares at him with burning red comic eyes and clenched fists, secretly plotting revenge.

scenes.script_text: Show respect for their opinion,
scenes.visual_concept: Maya bowing politely with hands clasped, nodding respectfully toward another stickman's spoken idea bubble on a clean pedestal.

scenes.script_text: and never say you are wrong.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai taping a bold red 'X' over a toxic megaphone labeled 'YOU ARE WRONG!', replacing it with an open bridge of dialogue: 'Let's examine the facts together.'

scenes.script_text: And Rule Number Nine: Let the other person feel the idea is theirs.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai discreetly planting a glowing lightbulb idea onto a desk, stepping back with a knowing smile as another stickman discovers it and exclaims: 'Eureka! I just had a genius idea!'

scenes.script_text: People support what they help create.
scenes.visual_concept: A team of energetic stickmen happily building a towering brick castle together, each proudly placing their own personal inscribed brick into the wall.

scenes.script_text: So tell me in the comments below.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai and Maya leaning forward toward the viewer with engaging 4th-wall comic smiles, pointing down toward an animated glowing comment box with tapping keyboard keys.

scenes.script_text: Would you rather win every debate with cold logic
scenes.visual_concept: An arrogant stickman standing atop a podium clutching a cold ice trophy labeled 'LOGICAL WINNER', wearing icy glasses with a sneering expression.

scenes.script_text: and walk alone in a room of bitter enemies?
scenes.visual_concept: The same debate winner walking down a dark, freezing hallway lined with former friends glaring in bitter resentment with arms crossed and backs turned.

scenes.script_text: Or stay humble, listen deeply,
scenes.visual_concept: A humble, warm stickman sitting attentively with an open posture, listening with deep empathy under a soft golden warm glow.

scenes.script_text: and build an unbreakable circle of loyal lifelong allies?
scenes.visual_concept: Single cohesive 9:16 vertical image split horizontally with central circular (VS) badge. TOP PANEL: The Arrogant Debater alone on a cold frozen summit, shivering with his logical victory trophy, surrounded by shadows of bitter enemies. BOTTOM PANEL: The Humble Listener surrounded by a warm, laughing campfire circle of lifelong loyal friends, sharing food and memories under golden stars. Bottom 250px subtitle safe zone clean.
